title: Guided reading: John 6:35
subtitle: Read metaphor, participle, and parallel claims.
overview: John 6:35 pairs two image-rich claims with two article–participle phrases. The grammar tells you who is described; the metaphor must be read in its literary context.
Notice the negated future verbs and parallel arrangement before drawing theological implications.

items.en: I am the bread of life.

items.grc: ὁ ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ πεινάσῃ, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ διψήσει πώποτε.
